test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 28 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A can do a piece of work in 5 days. B can do it in 20 days. With the assistance of C, they completed the work in 2 days. C alone can do it in ______________days.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__
Let the total work be the LCM of 5, 20, and 2 = 20 units.

Efficiency of **A** = 20 ÷ 5 = 4 units/day.

Efficiency of **B** = 20 ÷ 20 = 1 unit/day.

Combined efficiency of **A + B + C** = 20 ÷ 2 = 10 units/day.

Efficiency of **C** = 10 − (4 + 1) = 5 units/day.

Time taken by **C alone** = 20 ÷ 5 = 4 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by **A** = 5 days

Time taken by **B** = 20 days

Time taken by **A + B + C** = 2 days

**Formula Used:**

1/A + 1/B + 1/C = 1/Total Time

**Calculations:**
 
 **Person** **Days** **Total Work** **Efficiency** 
 **A** 5 20 4 
 **B** 20 1 
 **A + B + C** 2 10 
⇒ Efficiency of **C** = Efficiency of (A + B + C) − Efficiency of A − Efficiency of B

⇒ Efficiency of **C** = 10 − 4 − 1 = 5 units/day

⇒ Time taken by **C alone** = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of C

⇒ Time taken by **C alone** = 20 ÷ 5 = 4 days

**∴ The correct answer is 4 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM Method for Time and Work

Total Work is assumed as the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of individual days. This avoids working with fractions and simplifies calculations.

Work and Efficiency Relation

Efficiency is inversely proportional to the time taken to complete a work. Efficiency = Work ÷ Time.</p
